title: Markers panel: show markers in message order, and repair the three empty buttons beside its header
outcome: The markers panel always lists markers in the same order as their messages in the session, and the controls beside its header show what they are and work for keyboard and screen-reader users.
acceptance: Markers always appear in the same order as their corresponding messages in the session, including after a marker is added or removed, after older messages load, and across a reload. A regression test covers an order that would differ under the current behaviour.

The cause of the three empty button outlines beside the MARKERS header is identified and repaired, and each control shows its icon or text and has an accessible name. It is checked in a real browser in light and dark themes, with the before state reproduced, or the absence of a reproduction stated. Preserve what those buttons do, or say plainly if they should not exist.

cd ui && npx tsc --noEmit and vitest are clean, the required review pair has no Medium-or-higher finding, and the change lands under the standing rule. Greg is told the result through Engram::Asistant, including whether a reload or a restart is needed to see it.

completion.summary: Marker list uses session-wide message positions across bounded history windows; previous/next/hide header icons retain their intended size and native accessible controls. Exact reviewed candidate ec50c9d6 landed and UI asset index-Dz7AyhfT.js is served; reload required, no host restart.
